description: Tracked protocol parameters read at every history_samples target height (00:00 UTC samples) plus the latest final block; the cache behind rpc/protocol_changes.csv.
incremental_rule: Rows for history target heights are never re-read; the tip row is replaced each run (its config is the one the run already read for the snapshot). A failed read leaves no row (see protocol_changes.meta.json run.failed) and is retried next run.
sampling: One row per history_samples target date (1st of each month plus 2020-10-15, 2025-10-29, 2025-11-15, at that row's height: the last block with header.timestamp <= 00:00 UTC) plus one row at the tip (the latest final block of this run, dated by its UTC timestamp).

units.burnt_gas_reward: dimensionless exact decimal ([numerator, denominator] divided; a fraction, not percent)
units.max_inflation_rate: dimensionless exact decimal ([numerator, denominator] divided; a fraction, not percent)
